dct_title_s: Satellite Flood water Extent between the Nova Kakhovka Dam Wall and the Dnipro River mouth, Khersonska Oblast, Ukraine as of 21 June 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20230606UKR** This map illustrates satellite-detected flood waters along the 90km downstream of Dnipro River between the damaged Nova Kakhovka Dam wall and the Dnipro River mouth in Ukraine as observed from a Sentinel-1 images acquired on 21 June 2023 at 15:36 UTC. Within the analysed area of about 10,800 km², about 20 km² of land appear to remain flooded. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
